map.裸车 20 万元、残值率 5%（残值 1 万）、使用年限 5 年。直线法年折旧=: Vehicle price 200,000 yuan, salvage rate 5% (residual 10,000 yuan), service life 5 years. Straight-line annual depreciation = (200,000−10,000)/5 = 38,000 yuan, identical every year. Double declining balance uses rate 2/5 = 40%: year 1 depreciation = 200,000 × 40% = 80,000 yuan leaving a book value of 120,000 yuan; year 2 = 120,000 × 40% = 48,000 yuan; the last two years split the remaining book value less residual equally, so early depreciation runs far ahead of straight-line.
map.哪种折旧法对车主最直观？: Which depreciation method is most intuitive for owners?
map.直线法每年等额、最易理解，适合个人估残值；双倍余额递减与年数总和前期折旧快，更贴: Straight-line gives an equal amount each year and is easiest to grasp, suiting personal residual estimates; double declining balance and sum-of-years-digits are front-loaded, closer to the way new cars lose value fastest early, and are favored by companies. When pricing a sale, compare against the market rather than trusting a depreciation formula alone.
map.为什么新车第一年贬最多？: Why do new cars lose the most value in year one?
map.新车落地即转为二手车，购置税、保险、牌证等附加成本不计入二手车价，且首任车主溢价: A new car becomes used the instant it leaves the dealer; purchase tax, insurance and registration are not reflected in used pricing and the first-owner premium disappears, so first-year depreciation often reaches 15%–25% before easing. Luxury marques and slow-selling models suffer most.
